ctx.x: Did anybody ever get hurt out there?

Oh, several fellas got cut. They had one fella trying to pistol out, shot in the fire after the bullet glanced back and killed him. Jim. That's right. Did him right in his stomach. Boy by the name of, what that boy name again? I know his name. They said we could pass for twin brothers. That's how much we favored. Brother Grant. Brother Grant. That was his name. Shot in the fire half, I believe, and they had a steel sheet. Sheet iron in the fire half to protect the bricks. You know where they had burned all out…
Let's see, after you worked with August, who did you work with?
